newsitem.title: LATVIA: Lithuanian finmin expects second eurobond issue.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian finmin expects second eurobond issue.

text.p: Lithuania's Finance Minister Algimantas Krizhinauskas has said the country would probably issue a eurobond next year, even though it is likely that by that time the government will have changed.
A first round of elections are due in Lithuania on October 20 and the ruling Lithuanian Democratic Labour Party (LDLP) is expected to lose. Krizhinauskas is not in any party.
He told Reuters at a conference in Riga on Thursday that whoever forms the next government would need to issue the eurobond to refinance a borrowing issued at the end of last year.
He would not discuss the possible size of the bond.
"It depends on many factors," Krizhinauskas said.
But he said that the bond may be issued for a longer maturity, possibly for five years.
Lithuania issued a two-year $60 million eurobond at the end of last year and recently upped it by $50 million.
"Before the bond issue we will try and get another credit rating," Krizhinauskas added.
